name: meetbridge
description: A macOS Google Meet app powered by embedded Chromium.

scripts.build:safari-extension: xcodebuild -project MeetBridge.xcodeproj -scheme MeetBridgeExtension -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/safari-extension ARCHS=arm64 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:safari-extension && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/mac-arm64/MeetBridge.app dist/MeetBridge-${npm_package_version}-arm64.zip

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: MeetBridge uses your camera for Google Meet calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MeetBridge uses your microphone for Google Meet calls.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: MeetBridge captures system audio only when you choose to share it in Google Meet.
